def merge(arr, l, m, r):
    n1 = m - l + 1
    n2 = r - m

    L = arr[l:l + n1]
    R = arr[m + 1:m + 1 + n2]

    i = j = 0
    k = l

    while i < n1 and j < n2:
        if L[i] <= R[j]:
            arr[k] = L[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            arr[k] = R[j]
            j += 1
        k += 1

    while i < n1:
        arr[k] = L[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1

    while j < n2:
        arr[k] = R[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1

def merge_sort(arr, l, r):
    if l < r:
        m = (l + r) // 2
        merge_sort(arr, l, m)
        merge_sort(arr, m + 1, r)
        merge(arr, l, m, r)

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    a = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
    merge_sort(a, 0, n - 1)
    if n == 1:
        print(a[0])
    else:
        mid = n // 2
        print(a[mid])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
